description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandImpl within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.live.query package. It contains unit tests for immutability, equals/hashCode, null handling, command construction, getter methods, setting headers, and output string formatting.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandImplTest
classes.description: Unit test for the RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandImpl class, covering construction, immutability, equality, null handling, getters, setters, and string representation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test instances before each test case.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandImpl class is immutable and that JsonPointer is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the proper implementation of hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: tryToGetRetrieveAttributesLiveCommandForNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to factory method throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToGetRetrieveAttributesLiveCommandForCreateAttributeCommand
methods.description: Ensures that passing a command of incompatible type throws ClassCastException.

methods.name: getRetrieveAttributesLiveCommandReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that the command object correctly retrieves properties from the original retrieveAttributesTwinCommand.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that setting DittoHeaders on the command returns a new command with the expected headers.

methods.name: answerReturnsNotNull
methods.description: Checks that the answer method returns a non-null result.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method contains class name, command, and retrieveAttributesTwinCommand details.
